parties.petitioner: MAH. ADIWASI THAKUR JAMAT SWARAKSHAN SAMITI

summary: Scheduled Tribe status verification; constitutional provisions under Article 342; caste certificate issuance procedure; Madhuri Patil guidelines prior to Maharashtra Caste Certificate Act 2000; verification power of Scrutiny Committee; validity subject to proper anthropological verification; standard: strict adherence to statutory procedure; false certification debarment; verification mandatory for reservation benefits; procedural compliance upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Scheduled Castes Scheduled Tribes De-notified Tribes Vimukta Jatis Nomadic Tribes Other Backward Classes and Special Backward Category (Regulation of Issuance and Verification of) Caste Certificate Act 2000 s.6 s.9
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; verification process requirements reaffirmed; compliance with Madhuri Patil guidelines and Maharashtra Caste Certificate Act 2000 mandated.
